rubrics.justification: Accurately describes a good-quality expanded blastocyst with compact ICM, cohesive TE, and thinned zona consistent with 3AA; appropriately notes limits of a single static image, though some stage nuance is slightly hedged.
Comprehensively integrates age, ovarian reserve, tubal factor, prior IVF outcomes, sperm quality, endometrium, BMI, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and well-structured, with probability estimates tied to embryo grade and patient factors; only minor speculative elements such as hydrosalpinx/endometrial thickness nuance reduce perfection.

Recommendations are largely consistent with Gardner grading and standard IVF practice, including SET and cautious use of add-ons/PGT-A; minor overreach in discussing image-based euploidy correlation and some speculative caveats.
Provides clear, practical next steps for current transfer and contingency planning, including SET, luteal support, tubal/cavity reassessment, and selective future investigations.
